description: This file sets up and runs an asynchronous speech processing pipeline involving speech recognition, language model interaction, and text-to-speech output. It configures various services such as VAD, STT, TTS, LLM, and custom turn strategies, and orchestrates their execution within a pipeline.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds the context messages for the language model interaction.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Combines context with user parameters for aggregating LLM responses.

classes.name: LocalAudioTransport
classes.description: Handles audio input/output transport using local system resources.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps for audio and inter-language model interaction.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Defines a task with a pipeline and parameters to run together.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters controlling metrics and usage tracking for pipeline execution.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main asynchronous routine to configure and run the speech processing pipeline.
